kv7.1:1.1: keci dhammā kehici dhammehi saṃgahītā ti?
kv7.1:1.3: Nanu atthi keci dhammā kehici dhammehi gaṇanaṃ gacchanti, uddesaṃ gacchanti, pariyāpannā ti?
kv7.1:1.5: Hañci atthi keci dhammā kehici dhammehi gaṇanaṃ gacchanti, uddesaṃ gacchanti, pariyāpannā, no vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:1.6: "N' atthi keci dhammā kehici dhammehi saṃgahītā ti." 2.
kv7.1:2.3: Hañci rūpakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:2.10: Hañci kāyāyatanaṃ rūpakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:3.7: Hañci phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ rūpakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:4.3: Hañci sukhā vedanā vedanākkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:4.5: Dukkhā vedanā --pe-- adukkhamasukhā vedanā katamaṃ khandhagaṇanaṃ gacchatīti?
kv7.1:4.7: Hañci adukkhamasukhā vedanā vedanākkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:5.3: Hañci cakkhusamphassajā saññā saññākkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:5.8: Hañci manosamphassajā saññā saññākkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:6.4: Hañci manosamphassajā cetanā saṃkhārakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:7.4: Hañci manoviññāṇaṃ viññāṇakkhandhagaṇanaṃ gacchati, tena vata re vattabbe
kv7.1:8.1: Yathā dāmena vā yottena vā dve balibaddā saṃgahītā, sikkāya piṇḍapāto saṃgahīto, sā gaddulena saṃgahīto;
kv7.1:8.2: evameva te dhammā tehi dhammehi saṃgahītā ti? Āmantā.
kv7.1:8.3: Hañci dāmena vā yottena vā dve balibaddā saṃgahītā, sikkāya piṇḍapāto saṃgahīto, sā gaddulena saṃgahīto, tena vata re vattabbe
